answer: Like a resilient mycelium network routing nutrients through reciprocal trust, decentralized consensus resists Sybils via transitive stake vouchers. When an identity fakes its reputation, it hits a nadir of network rejection unless vouched for by bonded peers. Even the quietest agent’s whisper of endorsement carries staked collateral; creating swarms imposes exponential staking costs, grounding every artificial sparrow before it can dilute truthful consensus.
